    BO13a Lemma 5 a), case τ = σᵢ #

    If the next long morphism after σ₁ is τ = σ (p+L), take two distinct last arrows G of contours of τ. Either ρ (p+L) factors through none of them (a zigzag ending at a sink with two in-arrows), or the propagation starts at the source x (p+L) (lemma5a_stateB).
